name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Zprite
description:
Crisp. Zesty. Full of charge.

Zprite is a citrus-fueled burst of lemon, lime, and sweet fizz that hits like your favorite soda — light, refreshing, and impossible to put down. This uplifting sativa distillate fires up your focus and creativity with a clean, energetic high that keeps you moving all day long.

Powered by Platinum’s ultra-refined distillate and precision-engineered 2G all-in-one hardware, Zprite delivers smooth pulls, big clouds, and a flavor pop that won’t quit.

Flavor Profile: Lemon-Lime • Citrus • Sweet

Effect: Uplifted • Focused • Energized

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Smooth Draw Design
